[A]
SQL:
WITH interest_max AS (
    SELECT i.id, i.interest_name, MAX(im.composition) as max_composition, MAX(im.month_year) as max_month_year
    FROM interest_map i
    JOIN interest_metrics im ON i.id = im.interest_id
    GROUP BY i.id, i.interest_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT interest_name, max_composition, max_month_year,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_composition DESC) as rank_desc,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_composition ASC) as rank_asc
    FROM interest_max
)
SELECT interest_name, max_month_year, max_composition
FROM ranked
WHERE rank_desc <= 10 OR rank_asc <= 10
ORDER BY CASE WHEN rank_desc <= 10 THEN rank_desc ELSE 100 + rank_asc END

WITH max_composition_per_interest AS (
    SELECT 
        im.interest_id,
        imr.interest_name,
        MAX(im.composition) as max_composition
    FROM interest_metrics im
    JOIN interest_map imr ON CAST(im.interest_id AS INTEGER) = imr.id
    WHERE im.composition IS NOT NULL AND imr.interest_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY im.interest_id, imr.interest_name
),
max_rows AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        mci.interest_id,
        mci.interest_name,
        mci.max_composition,
        im.month_year,
        im.composition
    FROM max_composition_per_interest mci
    JOIN interest_metrics im ON mci.interest_id = CAST(im.interest_id AS INTEGER)
    WHERE im.composition = mci.max_composition
),
ranked_interests AS (
    SELECT 
        interest_id,
        interest_name,
        month_year,
        composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composition DESC) as rank_desc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composition ASC) as rank_asc
    FROM max_rows
)
SELECT interest_name, month_year, composition
FROM ranked_interests
WHERE rank_desc <= 10 OR rank_asc <= 10
ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN rank_desc <= 10 THEN rank_desc ELSE 21 - rank_asc END,
    composition DESC

WITH highest_comp AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(im.month_year) AS time,
        im2.interest_name,
        MAX(im.composition) AS composition_value,
        im2.id AS interest_id
    FROM interest_metrics im
    JOIN interest_map im2 ON CAST(im.interest_id AS INTEGER) = im2.id
    WHERE im.month_year != '' AND im2.interest_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY im2.id, im2.interest_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composition_value DESC) AS rn_desc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composition_value ASC) AS rn_asc
    FROM highest_comp
)
SELECT time, interest_name, composition_value
FROM ranked
WHERE rn_desc <= 10 OR rn_asc <= 10
ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN rn_desc <= 10 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    composition_value DESC
